label: SIRC Google Earth paper, 2006
basis: Nigel Stanger contributed “The view from the Chathams: Geovisualisation of web site hits using Google Earth” to Otago’s eighteenth SIRC colloquium in 2006. The paper applied a digital globe to location-based visualisation of website activity, linking database and web research with geographic display.
